describe: Hear a clip, then pick an answer: plays the game's melody clip for each `quiz` question and draws a Play again button above the question. Use it with `quiz`. The game writes its clips in `sound.clips` (authoring/SPEC.md 2.9); clip i is the sound asset `clip_<i>` and belongs to quiz question i (the question's content index, so content order and clip order must match; with fewer clips than questions it wraps). The clip plays `delay_ms` after each question appears (and after the first at the start); tapping the button (input `replay_clip`) plays it again, up to `replays` times per question and not while it is still playing. `clip_ms` is how long the longest clip lasts (the expander reports it): give quiz a `time_ms` of at least (`replays` + 1) × `clip_ms` + `delay_ms` + 3000, so people can hear every replay and still answer before the bar runs out. Emits `clip_play {clip}` each time a clip starts. State: `clip_now` (the clip playing or last played, -1 before any), `replays_left`. Sound is presentation only, so replays and scores don't depend on it.

_can_replay.body: not locked and replays_left > 0 and now >= _playing_until and clip_now >= 0

node.text: = if now < _playing_until then 'Listening...' else if clip_now < 0 then 'Get ready' else if replays_left > 0 and not locked then @label + ' (' + str(replays_left) + ')' else if locked then '' else 'No replays left'
node.progress: = if now < _playing_until then max(0.0, min(1.0, ((now - (_playing_until - @clip_ms)) * 1.0) / (@clip_ms * 1.0))) else 0.0
